exceptions.reason: Browser-support data that Next.js reads through browserslist at build time to pick compile targets; it is not code and is not bundled into the export. CC-BY-4.0 asks only for attribution, which third-party-licenses.txt gives, and carries no non-commercial or share-alike term.

Mozilla's root certificates as data, in the Cargo graph only as a wasm32-target dependency of rustls-platform-verifier, so no desktop build links it. CDLA-Permissive-2.0 is a permissive data license whose one condition, that its text travel with the data, third-party-licenses.txt meets.
